summary.text: John Blust is a Republican member of the North Carolina House of Representatives who has represented District 62 in Guilford County since his appointment in 2024 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.
He previously served in the House from 2001 to 2018 and in the state Senate from 1996 to 1998, according to Ballotpedia.

paragraphs.text: John Blust served in the North Carolina State Senate from 1996 to 1998 and in North Carolina House District 62 from 2001 to 2018, according to Ballotpedia.
The Guilford County Republican Party appointed Blust to the House on September 9, 2024, to replace John Faircloth, and he assumed office on October 9, 2024.
The General Assembly lists his occupation as attorney and accountant and his military service as U.S. Army, 1972 to 1974 and 1982 to 1985.
The Republican primary scheduled for March 3, 2026, was canceled.
